meta_data.base_class: Evaluate and improve the effectiveness of specific <types of plan> plan and provide recommendations - action schemes with structured goals, execution processes, and outcome evaluation mechanisms

tool_template.name: Evaluate_<class>_plan
tool_template.description: Generate structured evaluation feedback for a <class> plan based on provided evaluation data.

plan_id.description: The unique identifier for the <class> plan.

effectiveness_score.description: A score representing the effectiveness of the <class> plan, from 1 to 10.

evaluation_date.description: The date of the <class> plan evaluation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

comments.description: Comments or suggestions for improving the <class> plan.

goal_alignment.description: Indicates whether the <class> plan's goals are aligned with the overall objectives of the organization or individual.

implementation_timeframe.description: Estimated timeframe required to implement the recommended improvements in the <class> plan, in weeks or months.

risk_assessment.description: An assessment of potential risks involved in the current <class> plan and its proposed improvements.

stakeholder_feedback.description: Feedback from key stakeholders involved in the <class> plan, capturing their insights and recommendations.
